```{r}
# install.packages("devtools")
# devtools::install_github("jcbeer/longCombat")
library(dplyr)
library(lmerTest)
library(longCombat) 
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)
mydata <- read.csv("COMBAT_data/HABS_preCOMBAT_data.csv")
mydata$Volume  <- mydata$CortexVol

lh_thickness_cols <- grep("^lh_.*_thickness$", names(mydata), value = TRUE)
rh_thickness_cols <- grep("^rh_.*_thickness$", names(mydata), value = TRUE)

lh_area_cols <- grep("^lh_.*_area$", names(mydata), value = TRUE)
rh_area_cols <- grep("^rh_.*_area$", names(mydata), value = TRUE)

mydata[paste0("mean_", sub("^lh_", "", lh_thickness_cols))] <-
  (mydata[lh_thickness_cols] + mydata[rh_thickness_cols]) / 2

mydata[paste0("mean_", sub("^lh_", "", lh_area_cols))] <-
  (mydata[lh_area_cols] + mydata[rh_area_cols]) / 2

mydata$mean_WhiteSurfArea_area <- mydata$lh_WhiteSurfArea_area + mydata$rh_WhiteSurfArea_area

df = subset(mydata, !is.na(mean_MeanThickness_thickness) & !is.na(mean_WhiteSurfArea_area) & !is.na(eTIV.x) & !is.na(MRI_Scanner)  & !is.na(Age) & !is.na(Ethnicity) & !is.na(Gender) & !(MRI_Scanner==" ") & !(CognitiveStatus == " ")) 

dup_rows <- duplicated(df[c("Med_ID", "Visit_ID")])
df_second_row <- df[dup_rows, ]
df <- df[!dup_rows, ]

df <- df %>%
  group_by(Med_ID) %>%
  mutate(
    CS = if_else(all(CognitiveStatus == "CI"), "CI", "CU")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

df$CS = as.factor(df$CS)
df = df[df$CS == "CU", ]

# # count observations per subject
# obs_per_id <- table(df$Med_ID)        
# table(sort(obs_per_id, decreasing = TRUE) >= 1)  # at least 1
# table(sort(obs_per_id, decreasing = TRUE) >= 2)  # at least 2
# table(sort(obs_per_id, decreasing = TRUE) >= 3)  # at least 3
# sapply(1:max(obs_per_id), function(n) sum(obs_per_id >= n))

df$A0Z   = scale(df$A0)
df$dAZ   = scale(df$dA)
df$eTIV  = scale(df$eTIV.x)
df$YoE  = scale(df$YoE)

df$MRI_Scanner  = factor(df$MRI_Scanner)
df$Ethnicity    = factor(df$Ethnicity)
df$Gender       = factor(df$Gender)

df$mean_WhiteSurfArea_area = df$mean_WhiteSurfArea_area/34
df$mean_Volume = (df$lhCortexVol + df$rhCortexVol)/34

area_cols_ROIs <- grep("^mean_.*_area$", names(df), value = TRUE)
thk_cols_ROIs  <- grep("^mean_.*_thickness$", names(df), value = TRUE)

area_cols_loop <- setdiff(area_cols_ROIs, "mean_WhiteSurfArea_area")
thk_cols_loop  <- setdiff(thk_cols_ROIs,  "mean_MeanThickness_thickness")
region_names <- sub("_area$", "", area_cols_loop)
for (r in region_names) {
  df[, paste0(r, "_volume")] <- df[, paste0(r, "_area")] * df[, paste0(r, "_thickness")]
}
vol_cols_ROIs <- paste0(region_names, "_volume")

thk_cols <- c("lh_MeanThickness_thickness", "rh_MeanThickness_thickness")
area_cols <- c("lh_WhiteSurfArea_area", "rh_WhiteSurfArea_area")
vol_cols <- c("lhCortexVol", "rhCortexVol")

vol_cols_ROIs <- c(vol_cols_ROIs, "mean_Volume")

# pooled_cols <- c("mean_MeanThickness_thickness", "mean_WhiteSurfArea_area")

# df %>%

#   select(Med_ID, Visit_ID, MRI_Scanner, Ethnicity, Age)
```

```{r}
df_combat <- df[, c("Med_ID", "Visit_ID", "Age", "MRI_Scanner", "dAZ", "A0Z", "A0", "dA", "Ethnicity", "Gender","YoE", "CS", "eTIV", area_cols, thk_cols, vol_cols, area_cols_ROIs, thk_cols_ROIs, vol_cols_ROIs)]

combat_area <- longCombat(
  idvar     = "Med_ID",
  batchvar  = "MRI_Scanner",
  feature   =  area_cols,
  formula   = 'A0Z*dAZ + Ethnicity + Gender + YoE + eTIV',
  # formula   = 'A0Z*dAZ + Ethnicity + Gender + YoE',
  ranef     = "(1|Med_ID)",
  timevar   = "dAZ",
  
  data      = df_combat
)

combat_thk <- longCombat(
  idvar     = "Med_ID",
  batchvar  = "MRI_Scanner",
  feature   = thk_cols,
  formula   = 'A0Z*dAZ + Ethnicity + Gender + YoE + eTIV',
  # formula   = 'A0Z*dAZ + Ethnicity + Gender + YoE',
  ranef     = "(1|Med_ID)",
  timevar   = "dAZ",
  data      = df_combat
)

combat_vol <- longCombat(
  idvar    = "Med_ID",
  batchvar = "MRI_Scanner",
  feature  = vol_cols,
  formula  = 'A0Z*dAZ + Ethnicity + Gender + YoE + eTIV',
  # formula  = 'A0Z*dAZ + Ethnicity + Gender + YoE',
  ranef    = "(1|Med_ID)",
  timevar  = "dAZ",
  data     = df_combat
)

combat_area_ROIs <- longCombat(
  idvar     = "Med_ID",
  batchvar  = "MRI_Scanner",
  feature   =  area_cols_ROIs,
  formula   = 'A0Z*dAZ + Ethnicity + Gender + YoE + eTIV',
  # formula   = 'A0Z*dAZ + Ethnicity + Gender + YoE',
  ranef     = "(1|Med_ID)",
  timevar   = "dAZ",
  data      = df_combat
)

combat_thk_ROIs <- longCombat(
  idvar     = "Med_ID",
  batchvar  = "MRI_Scanner",
  feature   = thk_cols_ROIs,
  formula   = 'A0Z*dAZ + Ethnicity + Gender + YoE + eTIV',
  # formula   = 'A0Z*dAZ + Ethnicity + Gender + YoE',
  ranef     = "(1|Med_ID)",
  timevar   = "dAZ",
  data      = df_combat
)

combat_vol_ROIs <- longCombat(
  idvar    = "Med_ID",
  batchvar = "MRI_Scanner",
  feature  = vol_cols_ROIs,
  formula  = 'A0Z*dAZ + Ethnicity + Gender + YoE + eTIV',
  # formula  = 'A0Z*dAZ + Ethnicity + Gender + YoE',
  ranef    = "(1|Med_ID)",
  timevar  = "dAZ",
  data     = df_combat
)

harm_area_ROIs  <- combat_area_ROIs$data_combat  %>% select(-MRI_Scanner)
harm_thk_ROIs  <- combat_thk_ROIs$data_combat  %>% select(-MRI_Scanner)
harm_vol_ROIs  <- combat_vol_ROIs$data_combat  %>% select(-MRI_Scanner)

harm_all  <- merge(harm_area_ROIs,  harm_thk_ROIs, by = c("Med_ID", "dAZ"))
harm_all  <- merge(harm_all,  harm_vol_ROIs, by = c("Med_ID", "dAZ"))
```
